summary: Expanded POP math operator for selecting, combining, creating, pre-processing, post-processing, and optionally deleting point, vertex, or primitive attributes with sequential math blocks.

key_params.name: attrclass
key_params.note: Point, vertex, or primitive attribute class

key_params.name: lengthmismatchnotif
key_params.note: Notification behavior for input length mismatch

key_params.name: lengthmismatchaction
key_params.note: How shorter inputs are sampled when lengths differ

key_params.name: input0attrs
key_params.note: Selected attributes for an input block

key_params.name: comb0oper
key_params.note: Math operation for a combine block

key_params.name: comb0scopea
key_params.note: First attribute, component scope, or constant

key_params.name: comb0scopeb
key_params.note: Second attribute, component scope, or constant

key_params.name: comb0scopec
key_params.note: Third attribute, component scope, or constant

key_params.name: deleteattrs
key_params.note: Output attributes to delete after operations

key_concepts: Runs many sequential combine operations where Scope A, Scope B, and Scope C feed an operation and Result Scope receives the output.
Explicitly selects attributes across multiple POP inputs, unlike Math Mix POP's automatic input naming behavior.
Supports constants, vector components, swizzled scopes, and built-in underscore attributes in math scopes.
Uniforms, New, Pre, Post, and Output pages separate temporary values, generated arrays, unary preprocessing, reranging, and cleanup.
common_gotchas: Use Math Combine rather than Math Mix when you need explicit multi-input attribute selection or renaming.
Single-point POP inputs are treated as constants, which is useful but easy to miss when input sizes differ.
Keep/delete decisions on temporary attributes affect downstream POP memory and attribute availability.
